Materials, furniture & finishes

Everything we use in our own projects, from acrylic and HPL sheets to wardrobes, panels and hardware. Add items to a quote list and we will send you a price.

Furniture

  • Velvet Shell Dining Chair: A curved shell-back dining chair in soft velvet, on slim black legs.
  • Marble-look Dining Set: A marble-pattern table with six velvet shell chairs, made to fit your dining area.
  • Scallop Headboard Kids Bed: A playful scalloped, upholstered headboard that runs the full width of the wall.
  • Floating Bed with Cove Light: A platform bed that seems to float, lit from below with a warm LED cove.
  • Lounge Sofa Set: A deep-seated sofa arrangement for the living room, upholstered to order.

Kitchen & Storage

  • U-shaped Modular Kitchen: Shaker-profile shutters, lit glass-front uppers and a marble-look backsplash.
  • Gloss Wardrobe with Display Niche: A floor-to-ceiling gloss wardrobe with lit open shelving and a built-in vanity.
  • Louvred Wardrobe: Textured louvre-panel shutters with full-height aluminium profile handles.
  • Glass Crockery Unit: A lit glass-front display unit for crockery, with closed storage below.
  • Floating Vanity & Backlit Mirror: A wall-hung vanity with under-glow lighting and an organic backlit mirror.
  • TV Wall Unit: A wave-fluted TV wall with floating media storage and concealed wiring.
  • Study Desk & Wall Storage: A compact wall-mounted study desk with overhead cabinets and a lit shelf.

Sheets & Boards

  • HPL Sheet: High-pressure laminate in wood, solid and marble-look finishes for cabinets and panels.
  • Acrylic High-Gloss Sheet: Mirror-like acrylic in rich colours: the finish behind our gloss wardrobes and kitchens.
  • Laminate Sheet: An everyday laminate range in woodgrains and solids for budget-friendly furniture.

Services

  • HPL / Acrylic Board Pasting: We press your chosen HPL or acrylic sheet onto board, ready for cutting and edging.

Panels & Louvers

  • Fluted Wall Panel: Vertical fluted panels that add rhythm and texture to bed walls and TV walls.
  • Decorative Louvers: Slatted louvers for partitions, ceilings and feature walls.
  • Arch Feature Wall: A wood-panelled arch with brass strips and an art panel inside.

Hardware & Profiles

  • Aluminium Profile Handle: Slim edge-profile handles for a clean, handle-less look on shutters and wardrobes.
  • Glass Profile Shutter Frame: Aluminium frames for glass shutters on crockery units, wardrobes and partitions.
  • Brass Inlay Strip: Fine metal strips inlaid into panels and arches: the signature INERIM detail.
